---
title: "Per-tramo evidence contributions — trapezoid vs telescopic up/down"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)})
DIG <- "data/e743fd5"
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
## Row k is the TRAMO between rungs k-1 and k; tramo 15 closes at beta = 1.
## Lines are medians over blocks of 1536 iterations = 6 adaptation cycles
## (the raw series is a sawtooth of period 256, one reset per adaptation).
BLK <- 1536
scale_tramo <- scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "tramo", breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15),
                                      guide = guide_colourbar(barheight = 3))
```

```{r panels, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.8}
d <- fread(file.path(DIG, "evidence_contrib.csv"))
d[, blk := (as.integer(iter / BLK) + 0.5) * BLK]
b <- d[, lapply(.SD, median), by = .(i_beta, blk),
       .SDcols = c("trap_win", "up_win", "dn_win")]

## (a) the three estimators, per tramo, over iterations ----------------------
## all contributions are negative and span four decades, so the axis is the
## magnitude on a log scale
m <- melt(b, id.vars = c("i_beta", "blk"), variable.name = "estimator",
          value.name = "contrib")
m[, estimator := factor(estimator, c("trap_win", "up_win", "dn_win"),
                        c("trapezoid", "stepping-stone up", "stepping-stone down"))]
pa <- ggplot(m[contrib < 0], aes(blk, -contrib, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~estimator, ncol = 3) + scale_tramo +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "-contribution to ln Z (nats)",
         subtitle = "cold tramos on top: the last three carry 93% of the evidence") +
    theme_fig

## (b) how far the trapezoid sits from the telescopic bracket ----------------
## per tramo: the discretization bias of the trapezoid, tramo by tramo
b[, trap_minus_ss := trap_win - (up_win + dn_win) / 2]
pb <- ggplot(b[blk > 4000], aes(blk, trap_minus_ss, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + scale_tramo +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "trapezoid - telescopic (nats)",
         subtitle = "the trapezoid's O(dbeta^2) bias, tramo by tramo (post burn-in)") +
    theme_fig

## (c) the bracket width per tramo -------------------------------------------
## dn - up: where the 0.5-nat gap of the total estimate is generated
b[, bracket := dn_win - up_win]
pc <- ggplot(b[blk > 4000], aes(blk, bracket, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + scale_tramo +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "down - up (nats)",
         subtitle = "bracket width per tramo, post burn-in; sums to the total") +
    theme_fig

fig <- pa / (pb | pc) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
ggsave("Evidence_contributions.pdf", fig, width = 7.2, height = 6.8, device = pdf)
fig
```

```{r table}
tl <- d[iter >= 24000, .(trapezoid = round(median(trap_win), 3),
                         ss_up = round(median(up_win), 3),
                         ss_dn = round(median(dn_win), 3),
                         bracket = round(median(dn_win - up_win), 3),
                         trap_bias = round(median(trap_win - (up_win + dn_win)/2), 3)),
        by = i_beta][order(i_beta)]
tot <- tl[, lapply(.SD, sum), .SDcols = -"i_beta"]
knitr::kable(rbind(tl, data.table(i_beta = NA, tot)),
             caption = "Tail medians per tramo (last row: sum over tramos)")
```
